text: For $H\leq G$ and an $H$-representation $W$, the dimension of the induced representation $\mathrm{Ind}_H^G W$ is:
explanation: Since $\mathrm{Ind}_H^G W=k[G]\otimes_{k[H]}W$ and $k[G]$ is free of rank $[G:H]$ over $k[H]$, the dimension is $[G:H]\cdot\dim W$. Restriction is what leaves the dimension unchanged; $|G|\cdot\dim W$ would be tensoring over $k$; and $|H|\cdot\dim W$ confuses the index $[G:H]$ with the subgroup order.
